universe_count_outcome_blind.interpretation: expected catalogue-version drift; snapshot MUST be hash-pinned to one access instant

authorization: Real acquisition + protected scoring are gated on: venue-freshness re-verification, contract lock via isolated default-reject review, and an activation token. No per-event label has been read; only outcome-blind counts + synthetic runs.

axis_proxy_audit.rule: audit_features_against_axis rejects any field that is a proxy for the evaluation axis; enforces that B3_expanded_metadata_logit cannot be fit/scored on the temporal or geographic holdout.

baselines.desc: logistic on magnitude alone (strong simple baseline; magnitude expected to dominate)
logistic adding lat/lon/year; AXIS-RESTRICTED: forbidden on temporal + geographic holdouts; published only as a proxy-bearing sensitivity
XGBoost (Apache-2.0); registered ONLY IF the pinned build imports + passes a smoke fit

baseline_suite.domain_ipe_baseline: EXCLUDED with a machine-auditable reason (ipe_exclusion.json): the verified Atkinson-Wald (2007) DYFI IPE cannot be applied to the SOURCE_ONLY schema + tectonically heterogeneous population without inventing a site-distance covariate, a per-event ACR/SCR regime assignment, and a probability link. Explicit exclusion, not silent omission; reopenable by supplying those fields.
baseline_suite.tuning_rule: each learned baseline is tuned ONLY by the registered deterministic grouped cross-validation on the construction corpus over a REGISTERED grid; all baselines are named before external evaluation and carried unchanged to it; fixed comparator fits are not candidate method variants.

compute_envelope: local-only; FDSN fetch + tabular models on a few thousand events; no cloud/paid compute.

eligibility_filter.disclosure: data-informed (informed by exposed aggregate feasibility), registered before any per-event label is read; num_responses is used ONLY for eligibility and is forbidden as a feature.
eligibility_filter.rationale: below ~10 responses maxCDI is unstable/ascertainment-dominated (inherited 242/662 in the 2025 M5 slice)
eligibility_filter.rule: include an event only if it has a DYFI product with >=10 aggregated responses (num_responses>=10)

endpoint.definition: severe felt intensity == event-maximum maxCDI>=6 (reported shaking reaching intensity VI+)
endpoint.note: event maximum can flip across the threshold on a single outlier report; threshold-sensitivity + near-threshold counts + aggregation-grid sensitivity are reported so the endpoint is not read as a single-grid artifact. Deterministic from the frozen snapshot; independent of predictors.

estimand: descriptive-retrospective P(event-max CDI>=6 | source metadata) on a hash-pinned snapshot; evaluated once on a pre-hashed sequence-grouped temporal holdout (geographic transport secondary). No cross-system, real-time, lead-time, operational, causal, or winning-method claim.

fit_budget.enforcement: FitLedger counts every .fit() (each CV-fold fit and each final refit); the runner aborts if the cap is exceeded.
fit_budget.rule: the registered grid + CV folds + final refits across B0-B5 must not exceed the cap; the protected role is scored with frozen best_params and NO re-tuning.

leakage_inflation_headline.definition: report Brier/AUROC/log-loss across three splitting schemes at a fixed probe baseline: random_event, event_grouped (intermediate control; coincides with random on a one-row-per-event table), sequence_grouped (honest, leakage-hardened).
leakage_inflation_headline.reported_gap: Brier(sequence_grouped) - Brier(random_event) and AUROC(random) - AUROC(sequence), with uncertainty.
leakage_inflation_headline.status: this is the resource's primary quantitative result; no model is claimed to win.

metrics_and_inference.missing_class_rule: single-class slices/folds emit an explicit INFEASIBLE state rather than a spurious metric (missing_class_corpus fixture exercises this).
metrics_and_inference.ranking_rule: paired sequence-cluster bootstrap difference; classify each pair directional / equivalent / unresolved against a PRE-REGISTERED equivalence margin with an explicit tie probability (prob_a_better / prob_b_better / prob_tie).
metrics_and_inference.tie_and_infeasible_rules: INFEASIBLE/OK states are DERIVED from metric feasibility, not hard-coded (e.g. calibration_status=INFEASIBLE_CONSTANT_PREDICTION for the constant no-skill predictor; brier_status/bootstrap_status flags).
metrics_and_inference.uncertainty: sequence-cluster bootstrap, n_boot>=2000, 95% CIs on every reported metric and on paired baseline differences, with a minimum-valid-replicate rule.

no_selective_omission_contract.commitment: every registered baseline (B0-B5, subject only to the recorded XGBoost availability gate), every registered metric, every registered slice (temporal/geographic), every threshold in {5.5,6.0,6.5}, and every pairwise ranking is reported in the machine-readable results REGARDLESS of outcome. No baseline, slice, threshold, or comparison may be dropped after outcomes are read.
no_selective_omission_contract.enforcement: the one-shot runner emits the full per-baseline / per-slice / per-threshold / per-pair record (runner_result.json structure) and the report sets no_winning_model_claim=true.
exclusions_must_be_pre_registered_and_ma: the two quarantined inspected event ids
no_selective_omission_contract.unresolved_is_a_reportable_result: a pairwise difference classified 'unresolved' or a calibration_status 'INFEASIBLE' is reported as such; it is never suppressed or reframed as a win.

prehash_combined_digest_q5_transition.note: Re-pinned at activation for the authorized Q5 manual-quarantine addition; scientific plan unchanged.

protected_execution_sequence.step_2_retrieve_and_hash_products: pin product version id + access instant + payload sha256 per event; opens per-event source metadata -> AUTHORIZED ONLY after venue verification + lock + activation.
protected_execution_sequence.step_5_assign_frozen_roles: pre-hashed outcome-independent temporal (primary) + geographic (secondary) roles; publish role-manifest hashes.
protected_execution_sequence.step_6_leakage_audit: run the six-family audit + fixtures; must reject 100% seeded forbidden/proxy/straddle fixtures and accept only the exact clean schema.
protected_execution_sequence.step_7_freeze_baselines_metrics: tune B0-B5 on train/development over the registered grid within the 120 cap; freeze best_params.
protected_execution_sequence.step_8_assemble_release: source locators + hashes, licences, schema, endpoint def, role algorithm + hashes, leakage tests + fixtures, baseline configs + env lock, metrics/bootstrap code, machine-readable results, README + datasheet + data dictionary + CITATION.
protected_execution_sequence.step_9_one_shot_protected_scoring: external_runner opens the protected role EXACTLY ONCE with a single globally-consumed run token; carries frozen best_params; enforces B3 axis prohibition; derives INFEASIBLE states; reports the leakage-inflation headline. Currently interface-only (runner_interface_contract.json); NOT executed.

quarantine_rules.Q1_non_earthquake_event_type: quarry blast/explosion/ice quake/sonic boom removed independently of outcome
quarantine_rules.Q4_duplicate_authoritative_origin: keep latest authoritative revision; quarantine superseded
quarantine_rules.Q5_explicit_listed_quarantine_id: frozen reason-bearing manual list; currently empty in code, with two inspected event ids (ci40925991, us6000pgsd) added at activation as a logged non-silent change

reproducibility_guarantee: two clean local reruns from the release manifest reproduce role hashes, predictions, and metric JSON exactly (point summaries to <=1e-12; CIs to Monte-Carlo error). Determinism of the construction analytics is already demonstrated: two independent re-runs of both stage validators reproduced every emitted JSON artifact byte-for-byte.

role_assignment.primary_external_holdout: TEMPORAL: events on/after cutoff year 2023 form the external-holdout evaluation corpus; earlier events form train + development.
role_assignment.secondary_transport: GEOGRAPHIC leave-region-out variant reported as an internal transport check (still single-source USGS).

sequence_grouping.rationale: aftershock near-duplicates cannot straddle roles; the grouping key is registered before role assignment and reads no label.

six_leakage_families.control: forbidden-field audit; num_responses is eligibility-only, never a feature
space-time declustering; roles assigned by sequence cluster; audit_role_manifest rejects cross-role sequence straddles
six_leakage_families.example: a mainshock in train and its aftershock in the holdout

six_leakage_families.control: temporal cutoff; strictly disjoint time ranges; audit_role_manifest rejects violations

EXPANDED_METADATA.role: published ONLY as an explicitly proxy-bearing sensitivity (baseline B3); forbidden on the temporal and geographic axes it would leak

SOURCE_ONLY.note: lat/lon/origin_year excluded here because they are transport-axis proxies
SOURCE_ONLY.role: the ONLY schema scored on the temporal/geographic transport holdouts

strict_feature_schemas.audit_rule: leakage_audit.audit_feature_names accepts ONLY the exact schema (same members, same order); any extra/unknown field is rejected.

task: Binary classification of severe felt intensity (event-max maxCDI>=6) from outcome-blind event-level source metadata, evaluated under a leakage-safe sequence-grouped protocol on a single frozen USGS DYFI snapshot.
versioning_contract: the released resource is a dated, hash-pinned snapshot (v1 = <access-instant>); any later USGS revision defines a NEW version, never a silent overwrite.
